What we do

Three businesses, one engineering culture: equipment that moves and controls water, steam, gas and air, and the service network that keeps it running for decades.

Meridian Water

Pumps, treatment skids and network control systems for water utilities, irrigation districts and desalination plants. About Meridian Water.

Meridian Energy Systems

Valves, actuators and flow control for power generation, hydrogen production and LNG. About Meridian Energy Systems.

Meridian Infrastructure

Tunnel ventilation, fire suppression and building control systems for rail, road and airport projects. About Meridian Infrastructure.

Service

60 service centres in 14 countries maintain installed equipment under long-term contracts, which account for a third of group revenue.
